introHeading: The roaming booth along the Jersey City waterfront
introParas: An attendant carrying a lit, handheld capture system solves a specific problem at Jersey City's waterfront venues: nobody wants a backdrop stand blocking the Manhattan skyline view that Exchange Place and Paulus Hook rooftops are booked for in the first place. The roaming photo booth needs no floor space, no dedicated power run and no backdrop — the attendant comes to guests wherever they're standing, whether that's at the rail with the view behind them or seated at a Newport hotel ballroom dinner table.

Sessions take under a minute. Guests choose stills, GIFs or boomerangs, and the photo is on their phone by text or email before the attendant moves to the next group. That makes it a strong option for seated dinners and cocktail hours in Jersey City's waterfront ballrooms, where a static booth's queue would pull guests away from the water view they came for. For larger Jersey City weddings, we typically pair the roamer with a static booth — the mirror or vogue booth becomes the destination people seek out, while the roamer covers the tables and the cocktail hour without asking anyone to leave their seat.

It also works well for Journal Square and The Heights loft events and any Grove Street or McGinley Square venue with limited floor space. Jersey City is a short hop from our Brooklyn base, and there's no travel fee for most venues in the city — we quote it from your venue ZIP code before you book, so there's nothing to discover on the invoice afterward.

faqHeading: Roaming Booth in Jersey City — FAQ

faqs.q: How much floor space does the roaming booth need at a Jersey City venue?
faqs.a: None. There's no footprint to plan around, which matters at a waterfront venue where nobody wants a backdrop stand blocking the skyline view.

faqs.q: Do you charge a travel fee to Jersey City?
faqs.a: No travel fee for most Jersey City venues — it's a short hop from our Brooklyn base. We quote it from your venue ZIP code before you book.

faqs.q: Should we pair the roaming booth with a static booth for a waterfront wedding?
faqs.a: For larger Jersey City weddings, yes. The mirror or vogue booth becomes the destination guests seek out, while the roamer covers the seated tables and cocktail hour along the water.

faqs.q: What kind of Jersey City venues have you worked the roaming booth in?
faqs.a: Waterfront hotel ballrooms in Exchange Place, Paulus Hook and Newport, plus loft events around Journal Square and The Heights. Send us your venue name on the quote form and we'll tell you exactly what fits.

faqs.q: Does the roaming booth need power at the venue?
faqs.a: No. The handheld capture system needs no dedicated outlet, so there's nothing extra to coordinate with the venue.

faqs.q: Does the roaming booth print photos?
faqs.a: It's digital-first — photos go straight to guests' phones by text or email. Pair it with a static booth and printer station if you want prints too.

faqs.q: Is an attendant included with the roaming booth rental?
faqs.a: Yes. A trained attendant carries the capture system through the room for the full length of your rental.

faqs.q: Do you carry insurance and can you provide a COI for our venue?
faqs.a: Yes. We carry a $3 million insurance policy. If your Jersey City venue needs a certificate of insurance naming them as additionally insured, reply to your booking confirmation with their contact email and we'll send it over.
